Proud Source Water Joins Forces with Hyatt Centric Key West
By Proud Source Water,
19 hours agoKEY WEST, FLA.—Proud Source Water, a leader in sustainably bottled and packaged spring water, partnered with Hyatt Centric Key West to conduct an extensive marine debris cleanup effort at Rest Beach in the Key West Nature Preserve. The initiative is part of Proud Source Water’s Proud Planet Project, a community-based program focused on removing waste and promoting sustainability. It involves local cleanups, partnering with communities, and using 100 percent recyclable aluminum bottles to minimize plastic waste. The project aims to create a positive impact on the environment and promote responsible consumption.
